sentences.en: America has an elaborate system of constitutional checks and balances.
sentences.zh: 美国有一套复杂的宪法制衡机制。

sentences.en: The reporter elaborated on the method of his investigation.
sentences.zh: 记者详细介绍了他的调查方法。

sentences.en: The magician's use of smoke and mirrors was an elaborate facade.
sentences.zh: 魔术师利用烟雾和镜子制造了一个精心设计的假象。
